system.notes: Open-source oracle-layout baseline: predicted bboxes are copied verbatim from the ground-truth annotation; text is translated by NLLB-200-distilled-600M. Mirrors deepl-text-oracle but uses local open weights and covers all 8 LTB language pairs (including en-th and en-ms which DeepL does not support). NLLB-200 license is CC-BY-NC-4.0 — research use only; for commercial product, swap to MADLAD-400 (Apache-2.0) or Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt models (CC-BY-4.0).
